statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-18238 is an RPCAP client validation flaw in pcap-rpcap.c used only for remote packet capture. Debian libpcap is built without --enable-remote (default no); the Debian security tracker notes that binary packages are not built with experimental --enable-remote, so the remote-capture client code is not compiled into the shipped libpcap0.8t64 binary. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-18238

CVE-2026-18313 is a memory leak in rpcapd remote-capture server code. Debian libpcap is built without --enable-remote (default no); the Debian security tracker notes that binary packages are not built with experimental --enable-remote. rpcapd and the vulnerable daemon code are not present in the shipped libpcap0.8t64 binary. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-18313
